about: Shared test vectors of HJViewer's access tickets (docs/access-tickets.md), made by access-tickets.py next to this file: hjv-api signs a ticket, hbbs checks it at the punch hole request, the relay request and the registration, the app only carries it. The private keys are public test values: never use them for anything else.

use.hjv-api: for every ticket with fields: the payload of 2-3 made from the fields and signed with the key signed_by gives exactly ticket (signed_hex: the bytes signed); sub is Tagger::account of the login key under accounts.log_key_hex
use.hbbs: for every ticket and check: under rule, at now, the reason of 4-1 is expect; for every register_pk: the ticket read from field 1001 of the message and the reason at register_pk with its id and pk; for every access_conf: the rule read from the file, or error
use.app: register_pk 'ticket': a RegisterPk with these id, uuid, pk and hjv_ticket encodes to register_pk_hex

encodings: base64: standard with padding; base64url: URL-safe without padding; hex: lowercase; times: Unix seconds; signed_hex: the exact bytes the signature covers

builtin_text: HJViewer는 연세대학교 교직원용입니다. 연세포탈로 로그인하거나 이용 비밀번호를 넣어야 연결할 수 있습니다. HJViewer is for Yonsei University staff: sign in with a Yonsei portal account or enter the access password to connect. (access not allowed)
checks: at: punch_hole (target: PunchHoleRequest.id), request_relay (target: RequestRelay.id) or register_pk (id: RegisterPk.id; pk: the standard base64 of RegisterPk.pk); expect: the reason of 4-1. Under MODE=enforce every reason but ok is refused with the answer of its point; under MODE=count every request goes on and the reason is counted.

tickets.name: staff-ctl
tickets.why: a staff phone's ticket (24 h): any target, no registration

tickets.name: staff-ctl-key-2
tickets.why: the same ticket signed with key 2: both KEY lines are good

tickets.name: staff-both
tickets.why: the ticket of a staff member's Windows app (24 h): it connects anywhere and registers only its own ID and device key

tickets.name: bound-pc
tickets.why: a bound PC's ticket from its sync (72 h)

tickets.name: staff-pc
tickets.why: staff with use pc: a form hjv-api does not issue now, valid all the same

tickets.name: guest-ctl
tickets.why: a controller's ticket for the access password (12 h): one target

tickets.name: guest-ctl-custom-id
tickets.why: a target is compared byte for byte: a custom ID with - and _, and no case folding

tickets.name: guest-pc
tickets.why: a PC's ticket for the access password (12 h): its own ID and key

tickets.name: review-ctl
tickets.why: the App Review account's ticket: only the demo PCs of review.conf

tickets.name: longest
tickets.why: the longest ticket the rules allow: three targets of 64 characters

tickets.name: expires-in-a-second
tickets.why: exp one second after now: still valid

tickets.name: issued-60-s-ahead
tickets.why: iat 60 s after now, the skew hbbs allows

tickets.name: missing
tickets.why: no ticket (an empty token, no field 1001): every app before 1.8.0

tickets.name: oversize
tickets.why: 1026 bytes, a good signature: the size comes first

tickets.name: at-the-limit
tickets.why: exactly 1024 bytes passes the size check; its long sub breaks a rule after the signature

tickets.name: unknown-kid
tickets.why: a good signature by key 3, which no KEY line names

tickets.name: bad-signature
tickets.why: a bit of the signature flipped

tickets.name: bad-signature-payload-changed
tickets.why: exp made a day later after signing

tickets.name: bad-signature-no-domain
tickets.why: signed over the payload alone, without "hjv-ticket-v1" NUL

tickets.name: bad-signature-over-text
tickets.why: signed over the base64url text instead of the payload bytes

tickets.name: bad-signature-key-2-as-kid-1
tickets.why: signed with key 2 and named kid 1: hbbs checks only the key that kid names

tickets.name: bad-signature-s-not-reduced
tickets.why: S + L in place of S: refused by libsodium, ed25519-dalek and OpenSSL

tickets.name: payload-padded
tickets.why: the payload part of staff-ctl with its = padding

tickets.name: standard-alphabet
tickets.why: staff-both with + and / in place of - and _

tickets.name: signature-trailing-bits
tickets.why: the signature's last letter with unused bits set: a lenient decoder reads the same 64 bytes

tickets.name: signature-65-bytes
tickets.why: a zero byte after the signature

tickets.name: trailing-newline
tickets.why: the ticket and a line feed

tickets.name: payload-not-json
tickets.why: the payload is text, not JSON

tickets.name: member-twice
tickets.why: exp twice, the second a day later

tickets.name: guest-ctl-without-to
tickets.why: a guest controller's ticket for any target

tickets.name: guest-ctl-two-targets
tickets.why: a guest controller's ticket for two targets

tickets.name: ctl-with-id
tickets.why: use ctl with an ID and a key

tickets.name: iat-leading-zero
tickets.why: iat written with a 0 in front

register_pk.name: ticket
register_pk.why: the RegisterPk of a 1.8.0 PC: the app's generated code writes these bytes

register_pk.name: no-field
register_pk.why: the RegisterPk of an app before 1.8.0

register_pk.name: empty
register_pk.why: field 1001 there and empty: no ticket, as in proto3

register_pk.name: twice
register_pk.why: field 1001 twice: the last value counts, as protobuf reads a string

register_pk.name: varint
register_pk.why: field 1001 also as a varint: malformed, whatever else is there

register_pk.name: other-pc
register_pk.why: the ticket of 123456789 in the registration of 222333444
